subject.title: fix(telegram): Allow multi-agent ACP bindings within same account

question: Should same-account Telegram ACP binds in one topic create multiple independent session bindings, or only allow an explicit last-writer ownership handoff?
rationale: The PR states an independent multi-agent workflow, but the implementation and test encode replacement semantics, so maintainers need to choose the product contract before a repair can be safely automated.

options.title: Independent Bindings
options.body: Keep multiple same-account topic/session records and update routing to choose the correct target session without overwriting existing bindings.

options.title: Explicit Handoff
options.body: Allow same-account rebinding as a switch flow and update the PR description, tests, and proof to describe replacement semantics.

options.title: Keep Current Fence
options.body: Reject same-topic multi-agent reuse until a broader Telegram routing model is designed.

recommendation.title: Independent Bindings
recommendation.body: Keep multiple same-account topic/session records and update routing to choose the correct target session without overwriting existing bindings.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision intersects the plugin-state storage migration and Telegram runtime state contract this person introduced.
